answer: Plant submissions that are junk by construction and watch who approves them. Each epoch scatters a few honeypots — machine-verifiably empty, chaff dressed as grain across the grading field. An honest grader scores them low on merit; any grader who passes one lights itself up like a lantern against the dark and is slashed. The delta between a verdict and the known-bad ground truth needs no human judgment, so detection stays cheap and exact: a bright ember marking careless or colluding reviewers at the summit of the score scale.
